key_highlights: ASX sold off as mining and banking stocks tumbled; iron ore 'bloodletting' underway amid Chinese inflation surge and demand concerns
Oil surged near US$100/barrel on Houthi seizure of Yemen port and Iranian strikes on US jets, lifting energy names
AUD smashed on growth scare; RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate-cut path
Housing correction deepens at high end while affordable segment remains resilient; NSW stamp duty revenue hit looms
Australia softened gas reservation rules, easing Asian supply fears; gas policy shift under Albo government
Austal jumped on US$1.9b bid; Flagship increased copper exposure as red metal rallied
Woolworths breached its own 'Price Freeze' on four staples, reigniting cost-of-living scrutiny
Australian business confidence deteriorating; tax burden cited as key drag on sentiment

sectors.trend: Sharp sell-off; iron ore in 'bloodletting' phase, gold weak ('schmould'), but copper rallying. BHP, RIO, FMG under pressure. Flagship (FLG.AX) adding copper exposure. Austal (AUS.AX) surged on US$1.9b bid.
sectors.implications: Short-term headwinds for iron ore majors; copper and battery-metal names (Critical Resources, CR8.AX) offer relative strength. Diversify away from pure iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on geopolitical escalation (Houthis, Iran). Australia's gas reservation softening supports domestic gas producers. Power giant pivoting coal sites to AI data centres.
sectors.implications: Woodside (WDS.AX), Santos (STO.AX) benefit from gas policy shift. Coal-to-data-centre transition (AGL.AX, CGP.AX) is a structural theme. Oil strength supports upstream names.

sectors.trend: Banks dragged ASX lower alongside miners. RBA rental-inflation concern delays rate cuts, pressuring valuations. Bond yields rising on inflation fears.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure if RBA holds rates. Rising yields support NIMs but cap multiples. Watch RBA commentary closely.

sectors.trend: Woolworths (WOW.AX) breached Price Freeze on four staples, damaging brand trust. Cost-of-living and tax burden weighing on household spending. WES.AX under pressure.
sectors.implications: Consumer discretionary at risk; staples defensive but margin pressure from input costs. Monitor retail sales data.

sectors.trend: High-end housing prices in steepest correction; affordable segment resilient. NSW stamp duty revenue hit threatens state budgets. Bathla collapse creates buyer shortfalls. RentTech regulatory tightening in Victoria.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) face mixed signals—rental inflation supports yields but affordability constraints cap demand. Construction names cautious.

sectors.trend: Nursing graduates face rural 'trial by fire'—supply constraints persist. AI data-centre demand at coal sites signals tech-infrastructure crossover. No major ASX-listed tech catalysts today.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX stable but no catalyst. AI infrastructure theme benefits AGL, CGP, and listed data-centre REITs.

key_themes: Iron ore demand destruction vs. copper/battery-metal strength
Geopolitical oil spike (Houthis/Iran) reshaping energy complex
AUD weakness on growth scare; RBA trapped between rental inflation and slowdown
Housing bifurcation: high-end correction, affordable resilience
Gas policy liberalisation under Albo government
Rising bond yields and inflation fears pressuring equities globally
Business confidence erosion and tax burden as structural drag

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Iron ore price collapse / China demand weakness
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into copper (FLG.AX) and battery metals (CR8.AX)
Hedge AUD exposure; favour export-oriented miners and energy names that benefit from weak AUD

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA policy trap: rental inflation vs. growth scare
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid rate-sensitive REITs and construction; hold quality dividend payers (CBA.AX, BHP.AX) for income
Energy names (WDS.AX, STO.AX) as hedge; monitor Brent for sustained $100+ levels

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction spilling into credit
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor bank NPL data; avoid high-LVR REITs; watch NSW stamp duty revenue impact on state bonds
Reduce WES.AX/WOW.AX exposure; favour defensive staples with pricing power

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Australian gas and oil producers on geopolitical premium and policy shift
opportunities.rationale: Oil near $100, gas reservation rules softened, Asian supply fears eased—structural tailwind for upstream

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate from iron ore into copper and battery metals
opportunities.rationale: Iron ore in bloodletting; copper rallying; Critical Resources battery tech validated; Flagship adding Canadian copper

opportunities.recommendation: Position for AI data-centre infrastructure build-out at repurposed coal sites
opportunities.rationale: Power giant signalling coal-to-data-centre transition; structural demand from AI capex cycle

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gold-silver exploration plays on WA/NSW discoveries
opportunities.rationale: Kuniko and Gateway WA gold hunts active; gold weak short-term but discovery pipeline supports medium-term upside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce pure iron ore exposure; trim BHP/RIO/FMG by 20-30%
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting underway; Chinese inflation signals demand softness; ASX mining drag likely to persist

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness with energy and export-oriented names
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; exporters benefit from weaker currency; reduces FX drag on returns

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid high-end property and rate-sensitive REITs until RBA path clarifies
defensive_moves.rationale: Rental inflation keeps RBA on hold; high-end housing in steepest correction; NSW stamp duty hit pressures state credit

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain quality dividend income via large-cap banks and BHP
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising yields support NIMs; dividend yield cushion in volatile market; CBA/NAB remain defensive anchors

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure over 1-3 months. Iron ore weakness and AUD depreciation cap upside. Oil spike supports energy but broad market sentiment is negative. RBA on hold due to rental inflation. Expect volatility around 8,200-8,600 ^A200 range. Austal bid and copper rally provide pockets of strength.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if iron ore stabilises and RBA eases. AI data-centre build-out, gas policy reform, and battery-metal demand offer structural themes. Housing correction at high end may moderate by H2 2027. Key risk: sustained China demand weakness or further geopolitical escalation.
